forward_complete_set_calibration.decision_scope: current complete-set join/improve1/fade1 worker only; not transferable to B2 multi-leg completion probability
forward_complete_set_calibration.pair_fill_confidence_note: For zero paired fills in 217 probes, the one-sided 95% Wilson upper bound is 1.2314%; the upper endpoint of a two-sided 95% Wilson interval is 1.7395%. The calibration gate uses the one-sided bound. Neither statistic may be transferred across execution classes.

latest_pr_worker_evidence.interpretation: The PR-specific complete-set worker added another zero-fill window, while the direct B2 worker again produced no fills under its short stress replay. The B2 result remains measurement-limited and is not a completion-probability estimate.

latest_main_forward_maker_evidence.interpretation: The latest successful scheduled worker added a 480-second zero-fill window across 15 markets and left the repeated-session maker calibration with no eligible policy.

fast_shadow_latest_worker_health.interpretation: The fast shadow feed is healthy enough to serve as a read-only evidence worker, but it did not produce promotion-ready arbitrage evidence in this run.

measurement_integrity.reason: The current public trade replay parses timestamps to integer epoch seconds and the B2 probe snapshots REST books every 10 seconds. Therefore 250/500/750 ms scenarios are stress labels but are not empirically resolved arrival states and must not be counted as independent latency observations.
measurement_integrity.snapshot_ofi_role: post-decision realized-window diagnostic only; using it as a quote-time predictor would leak future information

interpretation.reason: The existing forward-maker worker observes two-leg complete-set/reward quotes, while current B2 candidates are five-leg factor hedges. Fill, queue, latency and completion distributions must be measured on the actual B2 execution class.
interpretation.current_complete_set_result: Fifteen independent persisted sessions now provide 217 probes per policy with zero paired fills. Join has one one-sided fill; improve1 has two one-sided fills and cumulative ex-reward PnL of -$2.4568 on its filled shares. The current complete-set passive maker sample is rejected more strongly as evidence of routinely achievable paired execution; this is not a permanent rejection of all maker strategies and is not transferable to B2.
interpretation.current_b2_result: The current validated live frontier used for this evidence snapshot has three raw-positive B2 candidates but zero maker-positive candidates. The direct B2 PR probe has 0/24 full completions and 0/24 rows with any fill in a 120-second window. This is negative execution evidence but remains too short and too coarsely timestamped to estimate B2 completion probability.
interpretation.next_experiment: Capture the actual B2 token books in event time with timestamp resolution finer than the 250/500/750 ms latency scenarios, compute strictly causal pre-arrival microprice/depth/imbalance/OFI, and replay the same legs under queue stress, partial/full completion, forced completion cost, and 60s/300s fill-conditioned markout.
